features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Primordial adds spells to your warlock spell list:

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | command, healing word |
| 2nd | lesser restoration, mud |
| 3rd | power word fling, revivify |
| 4th | power word rend, stone shape |
| 5th | conjure elemental, creation |

features.name: Convulsion of the Worldbuilder
features.description: At 1st level, as an action, choose a point within 60 ft and a shape: 30-ft cone, 30-ft × 5-ft line, or 20-ft burst. Each creature in the area: DEX save or take 1d8 bludgeoning and be knocked prone. Loose earth/stone becomes difficult terrain. 1/short or long rest. Damage scales: 2d8 (L5), 3d8 (L11), 4d8 (L17).

payload.name: Convulsion of the Worldbuilder
payload.description: Choose a point within 60 ft: cone/line/burst area. DEX save or 1d8 bludgeoning + knocked prone. Loose terrain = difficult terrain.

features.name: Redirection
features.description: At 6th level, when a creature you can see attacks only you, use your reaction to redirect the attack to another target within range of the attacker's weapon or spell. If the attack is a 4th level+ spell, succeed on a spellcasting ability check (DC 12 + spell level) to redirect it. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Redirection
payload.description: When attacked alone: redirect the attack to another target in range. 4th level+ spells require a spellcasting check (DC 12 + spell level).

features.name: Adaptive Shroud
features.description: At 10th level, when you take damage, use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn. Expend a spell slot to extend resistance for proficiency bonus rounds. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Adaptive Shroud
payload.description: When you take damage: gain resistance to that type until your next turn. Expend a spell slot to extend for prof bonus rounds.

features.name: Crushing Regard of the Primordial One
features.description:
At 14th level, as an action, choose one of:

**One Creature.** One creature within 60 ft: WIS save or 10d10 force + paralyzed 1 min (WIS save each turn to end). Success: half, not paralyzed.

**Multiple Creatures.** 20-ft radius sphere within 100 ft: CON save or 5d10 force + knocked prone. Success: half, not prone.

1/long rest.
